description:
Description
This mod brings seamless fleet sharing to Starsector! Export your fleet into a shareable string that another player can use to spawn it in their game. The shared fleet retains all its details, including:
- Fleet composition
- Weapons
- Weapon groups
- Fighters
- Captains
- Cargo contents

Challenge your friends to pit their "overpowered low-tech fleet" against your high-tech masterpiece, even with modded weapons, hulls, and captain skills!

Prerequisites
To use this mod, you need:
- Console Commands by LazyWizard: Download here
- LazyLib by LazyWizard: Download here

How to Use

Navigate to the intel screen to see the new UI

Use the export button to get a string representing your fleet to share with others, or import someone else fleet from your clipboard!

Sharing Your Fleet using console commands
1. In-game, open the console with Ctrl + Backspace.
2. Type the exportfleet command.
3. The shareable string is automatically copied to your clipboard.

Importing a Fleet
1. In-game, open the console with Ctrl + Backspace.
2. Enter the command importfleet SharedStringHere, replacing SharedStringHere with the shared string.
3. The fleet will spawn in your game.

Adding to your Fleet
1. In-game, open the console with Ctrl + Backspace.
2. Enter the command addtomyfleet SharedStringHere, replacing SharedStringHere with the shared string.
3. The fleet will be added to yours.

Importing a Fleet
1. In-game, open the console with Ctrl + Backspace.
2. Enter the command replacemyfleet SharedStringHere, replacing SharedStringHere with the shared string.
3. Your fleet will be replaced with the one from the string.

As a reminder you can use the UI instead of the commands

FAQ
- Can this mod be added or removed mid-game?
No, it cannot be removed during a campaign.
- What about mod compatibility?
The mod is compatible with all mods, but you must have the same mods installed as the player who shared the fleet.

Example Fleet (Vanilla)
My fleet (vanilla)


Download
Download the latest release: fleet share
Checkout the github repository: Github

Feel free to share your fleets, report bugs, or suggest features in this thread!

This mod was made possible thanks to community resources, including the Starsector wiki, open-source mods, and the official Starfarer API.

aiDescription: Exports a player's entire fleet composition, including ships, weapons, fighters, captains, and cargo, into a text string. Other players can use this string to spawn the exact same fleet in their own game via console commands or a new UI. It supports modded content as long as both players have the same mods installed.
